name: io.github.ShiftSad/librecad-mcp
title: LibreCAD MCP
description: Work a running LibreCAD (LibreCAD-mcp build) with AI: draw, inspect, measure and convert DXF/DWG

environmentVariables.name: LIBRECAD_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: LibreCAD Remote API address; leave it unset: by default the one in LibreCAD's discovery file, else http://127.0.0.1:13140

environmentVariables.name: LIBRECAD_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Remote API token (Options > Application Preferences > Remote API (MCP)); by default read from LibreCAD's discovery file

environmentVariables.name: LIBRECAD_API_DISCOVERY
environmentVariables.description: Path of LibreCAD's remote-api.json discovery file, when it is not at the OS default location

environmentVariables.name: LIBRECAD_API_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for LibreCAD on ordinary calls (long calls wait 50 s)

environmentVariables.name: LIBRECAD_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional folders (separated by the OS path separator) the server may open files from or write files to; any absolute local path when unset

environmentVariables.name: LIBRECAD_MCP_ALLOW_NETWORK_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow UNC and other network paths (refused by default)
